name: mixed_sources
description: A voltage source and a current source both driving node b (superposition example).
derivation: KCL at b (x12): 3(b-12) + 2b - 12 = 0, so 5b = 48 and b = 9.6 V. By superposition: the 12 V source alone gives 12 * 6/10 = 7.2 V, the 1 A source alone gives 1 * (4 || 6) = 2.4 V, total 9.6 V. I(R1) = (12-9.6)/4 = 0.6 A, I(R2) = 9.6/6 = 1.6 A.
